children.text: S C H O L L Y
Lots of the essays required for scholarships have very similar prompts. Write a general-purpose essay and tweak it for all your scholarship applications!
Just because a scholarship prefers a certain major doesn't mean it's required. Apply away!
Apply for a scholarship even if you think you have no chance of winning. You might be surprised!

You now have free access to Scholly's Resources, including advice from winning scholars and winning scholarship essays.

We don't sell your information like our competitors do. To keep the lights on, we charge a one-time fee of $2.99 to unlock full access to Scholly's award-winning scholarship matching and application tracking tools.
